speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling
text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport (a) whether inter-agency coordination is in place to support the timely deployment of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure in new housing estates as towns are progressively occupied; and (b) whether the Government will consider provisioning key supporting infrastructure earlier upfront to enable faster deployment in newer towns such as Tengah as resident demand builds up.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: For car parks with high demand, LTA will work with EV charger operators to deploy more chargers, electrical capacity permitting.

speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
text: In Tengah, many residents have approached me on EV charging infrastructure.

speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Tengah residents who already own EVs have shared that having charging points closer to home would make daily life much more convenient.

speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
text: And others are keen to make the switch, but are waiting for charging infrastructure to become more accessible.

speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
text: As Tengah grows, this will only become increasingly more important because residents want to embrace greener living.

speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
text: First, could the Senior Minister of State share how feedback from estates such as Tengah is operationally translated into changes in the planning and sequencing of EV charging deployment?

speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
text: And second, what adjustments have been made in inter-agency coordination to improve implementation in newer estates such as Tengah?
